description: Which EU countries, product categories (for example toys, cosmetics, electronics, textiles, food) and packaging register countries EuBinder covers, plus every rule_id with its title: the values that eu_obligations_checklist, explain_obligation and epr_packaging_register_lookup accept, and the optional business questions with their answer types. It lists values only; it does not work out which rules apply to a shop.
